mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name=#{name} WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE student_profiles SET name=#{name} WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_settings(user_id,homework_assigned,homework_changed,homework_due_soon,homework_overdue) VALUES(#{userId},#{homeworkAssigned},#{homeworkChanged},#{homeworkDueSoon},#{homeworkOverdue}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE homework_assigned=VALUES(homework_assigned),homework_changed=VALUES(homework_changed), homework_due_soon=VALUES(homework_due_soon),homework_overdue=VALUES(homework_overdue)
